boulderRoll.reason: Smooth airbrushed grey sphere reads as a moon or plastic ball, no rock facets, cracks or grit; dust smears below are detached. Shipped is crude but reads as tumbling rock.

hurlRock.reason: Smooth beveled cube looks like a plastic die, not a hurled rock; faint smeared trail on the left is weak. Shipped has a debris cloud and cracked shard.

talonRake.reason: Three tapered claw slashes with bone-and-rust tips, clean alpha, reads instantly as a rake at 80px, grim and restrained. Far better than shipped smeared water-like streak.

tentacleLash.reason: Clean teal curved tentacle with tapered tip and dark underside, no fringe, strong silhouette. Slightly smooth, no suckers, but beats the shipped lumpy blue noodle.
